feedback.problem:
Find $Mz$ if 
$M=[\begin{aligned}s & t \\ -t & s\end{aligned}]$
and
$z=[\begin{aligned}s \\ t\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Mz & =[\begin{aligned}s & t \\ -t & s\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}s \\ t\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}s\cdot s+t\cdot t \\ (-t)\cdot s+s\cdot t\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{s}^{2}+{t}^{2} \\ -st+st\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}{s}^{2}+{t}^{2} \\ 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
